title: Mediated Disclosure
abstract: arXiv:2610.36490v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce a mediator to a communication setting with verifiable (hard) evidence and characterize precisely when mediation can induce every obedient outcome--every type-contingent distribution of actions that the receiver is willing to follow--including the outcome that delivers the sender's commitment (Bayesian persuasion) payoff. For both type-independent and general preferences, it is necessary for each type to have a message he alone can send. This is also sufficient for type-independent preferences, whereas the general case also requires a particular alignment of the types' utilities. We also rank evidence structures by the distributions of actions conditional on the sender's type that they can induce at (mediated) equilibrium, through garbling conditions analogous to Blackwell's comparison of experiments.

translated_abstract: 我们在一个包含可验证（硬）证据的沟通环境中引入中介，并精确刻画了中介何时能够实现每一个服从性结果——即接收者愿意遵循的、依赖于发送者类型的每一种行动分布——包括能够为发送者带来承诺（贝叶斯说服）收益的结果。对于类型无关偏好和一般偏好两种情形而言，每个类型都拥有一条只有他自己才能发送的信息是必要条件。这一条件对于类型无关偏好而言也是充分的；而在一般情形下，还需要各类型的效用之间存在特定的对齐关系。此外，我们还借助与Blackwell实验比较类似的加扰条件，依据各证据结构在（有中介）均衡下所能诱导出的、以发送者类型为条件的行动分布，对证据结构进行排序。
tldr: 本文在含可验证证据的沟通模型中引入中介，精确刻画了中介能够实现所有服从性结果（包括发送者的贝叶斯说服收益）的充要条件，并通过类比Blackwell实验比较的加扰条件对证据结构进行排序。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a mediator into a communication setting with verifiable evidence, precisely characterizes when mediation can induce every obedient outcome—including the sender's Bayesian persuasion payoff—and ranks evidence structures through garbling conditions analogous to Blackwell's comparison of experiments.
